patch_description:
The current program has depth 39 and shows degraded performance (score 0.66) compared to the prior best (0.67 with depth 26). The doubled motif structure added complexity without improving worst_group_margin or validation accuracy. 

This edit removes the inefficient second motif repetition and instead adds a minimal ZZ sublayer immediately after the CRX gates in the first motif. The ZZ gates act on the same nearest-neighbor pairs (0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-7) with the shared "ent_nn" parameter, complementing the X-Y Ising interactions with Z-axis entanglement. This approach:
- Restores depth closer to the prior best (saving ~13 gates)
- Adds targeted expressivity without full motif duplication
- Maintains parameter economy (no new distinct parameters)
- Reuses proven architectural principles
